noun_data.noun_definition: The right arrow key is a keyboard key used to navigate or cycle through items in a user interface.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, the right arrow key is configured to trigger an action that cycles through attachments in a forward direction when pressed.

noun_data.noun_definition: The right edge is the boundary of an object or area that is furthest to the right side.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, the right edge is used to determine if the tooltip for a display name should be shifted horizontally based on whether the inline text node overflows the container's right edge.

noun_data.noun_definition: Right input refers to the correct or appropriate data entered into a text input field in a user interface.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the context of the BaseTextInput function, the right input is crucial for activating or deactivating the label based on user interaction and the value entered, ensuring that the input field behaves correctly as a controlled or uncontrolled component.
